item.title: Greater Amman Municipality declares maximum emergency starting Wednesday morning - Jordan News | Latest News from Jordan, MENA
item.description: The Greater Amman Municipality has announced a state of maximum emergency starting Wednesday morning to deal with the weather depression affecting the Kingdom.

item.title: "Disappear After Reading": WhatsApp’s Upcoming Feature for Ultimate Privacy - Jordan News | Latest News from Jordan, MENA
item.description: WhatsApp, owned by Meta, is developing a new feature for Android users that allows messages to vanish automatically once they have been read.

item.title: Iran Appoints Mohammad Baqer Zolghadr as National Security Chief - Jordan News | Latest News from Jordan, MENA
item.description: The Iranian Presidency has officially announced the appointment of Mohammad Baqer Zolghadr as the new Secretary-General of the Supreme National Security Council (SNSC), succeeding Ali Larijani.

item.title: Lebanon Expels Iranian Ambassador and Recalls Envoy from Tehran - Jordan News | Latest News from Jordan, MENA
item.description: The Lebanese Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Emigrants announced on Tuesday the summoning of the Iranian Chargé d'Affaires in Lebanon, Tawfiq Samadi Khoshkho. During the meeting with the Ministry’s Secretary-General, Ambassador Abd Al-Sattar Issa, the Lebanese state’s official decision was delivered.

item.title: Parliament Includes Real Estate Ownership Amendment Bill on its Agenda - Jordan News | Latest News from Jordan, MENA
item.description: The House of Representatives has officially included the Draft Amended Real Estate Ownership Law of 2026 on the agenda for its session scheduled for tomorrow, Wednesday, at 11:00 AM.

item.title: Occupation Continues Closure of Al-Aqsa Mosque for 25th Consecutive Day - Jordan News | Latest News from Jordan, MENA
item.description: Occupied Jerusalem — Israeli occupation authorities continue to close the Blessed Al-Aqsa Mosque/Al-Haram Al-Sharif for the 25th consecutive day, banning prayers under the pretext of security conditions related to the ongoing regional war. The city is witnessing stringent military measures and the total isolation of the Old City from its surroundings.

item.title: Qatari Foreign Ministry: "The Total Destruction of Iran is Not an Option" - Jordan News | Latest News from Jordan, MENA
item.description: The spokesperson for the Qatari Ministry of Foreign Affairs, Majed Al-Ansari, affirmed that ending the current war through diplomatic means remains Qatar’s steadfast position, emphasizing his country's support for all official and unofficial diplomatic channels.

item.title: 6 Peshmerga Killed, 30 Wounded in Missile Attack North of Erbil - Jordan News | Latest News from Jordan, MENA
item.description: The Kurdistan Region of Iraq announced on Tuesday the killing of 6 Peshmerga fighters and the wounding of 30 others during attacks targeting their forces north of Erbil.

item.title: Civil Defense Responds to 6,279 Incidents During Eid al-Fitr - Jordan News | Latest News from Jordan, MENA
item.description: Amman — The Civil Defense Directorate (CDD) announced that its teams handled a total of 6,279 different incidents during the Eid al-Fitr holiday. The operations included 5,338 medical emergencies, 210 fire-related incidents, and 731 rescue missions.

item.title: King, Sultan of Oman Discuss Ways to De-escalate Regional Tensions via Phone - Jordan News | Latest News from Jordan, MENA
item.description: Amman — His Majesty King Abdullah II and His Majesty Sultan Haitham bin Tariq of Oman discussed ways to reduce regional escalation during a phone call on Tuesday.
